rationale: Reached transitively through next (a production dependency of apps/web), so npm audit --omit=dev still reports it — it is not purely dev-only by that test. But COMPLIANCE_GAPS.md GAP-002's own criterion is reachability from code that RUNS in the deployed container: postcss's vulnerable surface here is source-map / CSS-comment parsing invoked by Next.js's build-time CSS pipeline, not by any code path that executes while apps/web is serving a request. Recorded here per the Product Owner's 2026-09-24 GAP-002 disposition rather than left as a silent pass, pending the Security Guardian's own triage and a next/postcss upgrade.
